reviews.text: Zac is prompt on reply and on time for appointment… he brought the whole workshop tools. He is super detailed… the whole interior is super clean!
…let me watch him 8am to 3pm to do deep washing, polishing, detailing..iPa and coating! … I had alot of stains… Zac solved everything!
did the sonax carspa with sgautobots. very detailed and professional, trustworthy and cares about his work
Very detailed in his work. Friendly and approachable. Will not hardsell on packages.
Contacted Zac for a car spa… Explained everything clearly. Car looks and smells new again.
Fast response, i enquired and immediately got a booking for next day afternoon. Punctual and meticulously revived my full leather sand beige interior.
He did a thorough pest fumigation, detailed car wash, and wet vacuum of upholstery…
He is super detailed on all the small details that other detailers will miss out.
